summary: 修复 TEST-I9-ENTRY-CONTRACT-DISCONNECTED：在现有 Alembic main/daemon strict production 入口增加一个最小、版本化、可哈希的 pre-mutation setup authority port，使 accepted artifact 能在不预创建 pristine dataRoot 的情况下消费 controller-bound external evidence/journal/operation-lock/snapshot/path-plan/pre-reset/restore authority，并为 authorized rebuild 提供 whole-root snapshot、disposable restore probe、失败后的 exact restore/reselection；不得新增第二编排器、Test adapter、Plugin/MCP 依赖或通用任意路径 API。实现必须保持现有 strict Plan→Analyst→Producer→G1/G2/G3/G4→tool-neutral serving→CAS 主链不变。Pristine：authorization/load receipts 与 fsynced StrictRunJournalHeader 位于 target 外，planned absence 通过后才 supported init，snapshot/reset 均 N/A。Rebuild：在 external root-identity lease 下冻结 pre-reset publication/reader/config/marker/baseline，whole-root snapshot 到非重叠 external root，disposable restore equality 后才 exact allowlist reset；任一 pre-CAS/T6 failure 能在 lease 下 restore snapshot 并重选精确 pre-reset reader mode。所有 source/other Ghost/config/credential/target-snapshot-evidence overlap 均 fail closed；不持久化 secret 或用户绝对路径。连接真实 HTTP/job/main/daemon 入口与 fresh-process resume，覆盖 symlink/overlap/hash drift/live-owner/partial snapshot/restore mismatch/crash before-after reset/CAS conflict。完整运行 Alembic targeted + full check/test/build/package gates，产出一个 clean commit；回填 parent/commit/tree、请求/收据 schema、实际调用链、RED→GREEN、原始命令摘要、外部拓扑脱敏收据样例、恢复等价证据、边界扫描和两阶段自审。完成后仅回总控；不得运行真实 Test 或修改任何 Ghost root。
designIntent: 延伸现有 strict production request/authorization/orchestrator/reset 能力，使已确认的外部安全与恢复合同真正可由生产入口执行；只补断链，不新建平台或改变 Recipe 质量门禁。

targetTasks.summary: Alembic Main：以一个最小受支持 setup authority/restore port 接通 N1，保证 pristine 不预建 target、rebuild 使用 external whole-root snapshot/restore；一个 clean commit，完整验收证据。
